raw_segments.text: Seven hundred, seven hundred, not five hundred, at once, this minute, cashed down.
I can't give you the whole three thousand straight off.
If I give it, you may come back to her tomorrow.
Besides, I haven't the three thousand with me.
I've got it at home in the town, faltered Midia, his spirit sinking at every word he
Upon my word, the money's there, hidden.
